title: eml-ice40-cybenko: code and data for Valid and False Snapping in EML Expression Trees
description: Code (eml_layer_v2.py, experiment_v2.py, basin_warmstart.py), paper source, and data for 'Valid and False Snapping in EML Expression Trees: The Basin Selection Problem'. v2.4 adds the warm-start/curriculum basin-selection note (notes/basin_selection_warmstart_note.md) with the canonical 120-row post-fix dataset (results/basin_warmstart_v2.4_postfix.csv, 20 seeds x {ln d=5, exp d=3} x {blind, warm, curriculum}): warm-start recovery 100% for exp d=3 and ln d=5, blind 25-35%, with auditable pretrain_form column and deterministic seeding. Includes the original 240-run v2.2 sweep CSV, the pre-fix v2.3 diagnostic corpus, and all figures.
